messages:
maria_cs: Kicking off wk42 enroller cohort onboarding — quick sync pls: 1) who owns kickoff invites 2) is the feedback capture ready (day 3 + day 14) 3) renewal-risk signal thresholds? Need owners by EOD. :spiral_calendar:

devon_se: I can take invites. Do we use the new 'Beta Kickoff v3' event template or keep v2? Also need the enablement deck link so I can attach to the invite.

maria_cs: Use Beta Kickoff v3 (updated with rate-limit guidance). Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/beta-kickoff-v3 (internal). I'll paste the FAQ snippet in the thread for the invite body.

ashley_p: Drafted the pulse survey for day 3 + day 14 — 2 quick questions + an open text box. Draft form: https://forms.gle/rdwKxYpEXAMPLE — short, mobile-first. Plan: automation sends after first successful call and day 14.

sam_k: For renewal-risk signal: suggest flag if <50 API calls OR <$25 token spend in first 14 days. Also flag if enablement event no-show + no follow-up message within 48h. Tag as `renewal-risk-60d` for tracking. Thoughts?

devon_se: Agreed on thresholds. I'll add instrumentation to track "first_14d_calls" and "first_14d_spend" and emit an org tag. Can I get the list of expected baseline per cohort?

maria_cs: Baseline for this cohort (enroller-alpha): expected 200 calls / wk per account. I exported the roster + baseline to /shared/preview/enroll/wk42.csv — please use that. I'll DM the file if you can't access.

ashley_p: For feedback routing: day3 -> CS pulse (auto), day14 -> product feedback queue (jira: PRODBETA-123). I'll add a short snippet asking for "biggest blocker" and "suggested improvement".

sam_k: Can we also add a small telemetry check: whether they hit 95th percentile latency >1.2s within first 72h -> escalate to eng-runbooks. That tends to predict frustration.

devon_se: OK I'll wire an alert to #eng-runtime with tag `beta-latency-wk42` if >3 accounts hit that latency.

pilot-bot: Reminder: scheduled event created by devon_se for "Enroller Cohort A - Kickoff" on Mon 09:00 PT. Participants: cohort-alpha.ics.

maria_cs: Thanks @devon_se and @ashley_p. Volunteers: devon = invites + calendar; ashley = pulse + routing; sam = risk thresholds + tagging; I will handle 1:1 reachouts for accounts flagged as low-usage (first pass).

devon_se: Added the enablement deck link to the calendar invite and attached the quickstart snippet: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}'```

ashley_p: One ask: can CSs have a short checklist to run during the 1:1? e.g., 1) confirm API key + billing, 2) run sample generate, 3) open feedback form together. I'll draft and drop into the shared folder.

maria_cs: Yes please. Also adding a column in the roster: "enablement_status" (not-started / in-progress / done) so we can chart adoption cadence.

sam_k: I'll create an automation rule: when enablement_status changes to done -> remove `renewal-risk-60d` tag. When first_14d_calls <50 at day 14 -> send CS slack alert with recommended script.

maria_cs: Final: owners noted. Follow-ups: devon to confirm calendar invites by EOD, ashley to publish pulse form and mapping to jira, sam to push tagging instrumentation, I'll run the reachout list tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

devon_se: Confirmed, invites scheduled.

maria_cs: Thanks team — tagging @here for visibility. Will post a short recap in the cohort Confluence page after the kickoff.
